content:
- Model consistently overestimates prices in early forecast periods, especially after recent spikes.
- Underestimates prices in the first 5–10 days of the forecast horizon, then gradually catches up.
- Overshoots after sharp upward spikes in history (e.g., 73+), then corrects with a lagged downward bias.
- Mean reversion bias: model tends to overcorrect downward after high peaks, underestimating true mean.
- Forecast horizon 30d: model exhibits persistent lag in capturing true trend direction, especially in late period (days 20–30).
- Model underestimates true volatility in early period (days 1–10) but overestimates in late period (days 20–30) — inconsistent variance capture.
- Strong bias toward lower end of price range in first 10 days, then gradually shifts upward — suggests model lacks early momentum sensitivity.
- Model fails to adjust for cumulative effect of recent high prices — tends to underestimate true price levels after 20+ days of high history.
